verdict.rationale: Semgrep's own Semgrep Assistant does AI post-processing of findings to reduce noise by about 20%, and the vendor markets AI reasoning for triage, which covers flagging likely false positives. The community tool that feeds SARIF into LLMs is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented AI explanations of findings, AI-based deduplication, in-depth first-party docs on Assistant triage behavior, independent hands-on corroboration of Assistant's false-positive accuracy.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI to triage findings — explaining them, deduplicating, and flagging likely false positives

citations.quote: Contextual post-processing of findings with Semgrep Assistant (AI) to further reduce noise by ~20%
Combine AI reasoning with rule-based analysis for detection, triage, and remediation
